mapper.insert: insert into t_device (username, device_id, device_name, crt_time, last_seen, revoked, token_version) values (#{username,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{crtTime,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{lastSeen,jdbcType=BIGINT}, 0, ifnull(#{tokenVersion,jdbcType=INTEGER}, 0)) on duplicate key update device_name = values(device_name), last_seen = values(last_seen), -- 重新注册视为解除注销。token_version 故意不更新： -- 注销时已经自增过，旧令牌仍然无效；重新登录签发的令牌才带新版本。 revoked = 0
mapper.select:
select
from t_device where username = #{username,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and revoked = 0 order by last_seen desc
select count(*) from t_device where username = #{username,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and revoked = 0
